deluxe.description: For an elevated stay, our Deluxe Duplex Suites - Emerald, Jade, Onyx, and Topaz - offer a two-level retreat with luxurious comfort. These spacious suites feature a stylish living area on the lower level and a private bedroom on the upper level, providing a sense of exclusivity and home-like convenience. With high ceilings, elegant décor, and expansive windows, each suite is bathed in natural light, creating an inviting atmosphere. Guests can enjoy premium amenities, a well-equipped workspace, and a lavish bathroom with high-quality fittings. Perfect for families or travelers seeking extra space, our Duplex Suites redefine boutique luxury.
deluxe.subtitle: Delightful blend of comfort and style
deluxe.title: Deluxe Rooms

handicapped.description: Our Handicapped Room is designed with accessibility and comfort in mind, ensuring a seamless and enjoyable stay for guests with mobility challenges. The room features wider doorways, lowered amenities, and an easily accessible layout for convenience. The bathroom is fully equipped with grab bars, a roll-in shower, and other necessary adaptations to provide safety and ease of use. With modern furnishings, premium bedding, and essential in-room technology, this space offers the same level of comfort as our other rooms, ensuring every guest experiences the warmth and luxury of Chortoq Boutique Hotel without limitations.
handicapped.subtitle: Expertly designed to offer the ultimate in comfort and accessibility.
handicapped.title: Handicapped Rooms

presidential.description: The epitome of luxury, our Presidential Suite offers an exclusive haven of elegance and sophistication. Featuring a spacious bedroom, a separate living area, and a private dining space, this suite is designed for ultimate comfort. Opulent interiors, premium furnishings, and bespoke details create an ambiance of refined indulgence. The lavish bathroom, equipped with a deep soaking tub and premium toiletries, provides a spa-like retreat. Ideal for high-profile guests or those celebrating special occasions, the Presidential Suite promises an unforgettable experience, blending privacy, grandeur, and world-class hospitality in the stunning setting of Chortoq Boutique Hotel.

sanatorium.description: Our Sanatorium Rooms offer a peaceful haven tailored for wellness and rejuvenation. Designed with soothing decor and equipped with ergonomic furniture, these rooms provide the ideal environment for guests undergoing therapeutic treatments. Located close to our world-class wellness facilities, each room is crafted to promote tranquility and support a holistic healing experience, ensuring guests leave feeling revitalized and restored.

standard.description: Designed for comfort and convenience, our Standard Rooms provide a cozy retreat with modern amenities and elegant interiors. Featuring plush bedding, a functional workspace, and stylish décor, these rooms ensure a restful stay for both business and leisure travelers. Large windows offer scenic views, enhancing the serene atmosphere. Each room is equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi, a smart TV, and a well-appointed bathroom with premium toiletries. Thoughtfully designed to maximize space and comfort, our Standard Rooms are perfect for guests seeking a blend of sophistication and relaxation during their stay at Chortoq Boutique Hotel.

suites.description: Elegance meets comfort in our Suites, designed for travelers seeking extra space and refined luxury. Named Jasmine, Iris, and Lotus, each suite offers a separate sitting area, creating a sophisticated ambiance for relaxation or work. Thoughtfully curated interiors blend modern aesthetics with local charm, ensuring a warm and inviting atmosphere. Guests can enjoy plush furnishings, premium bedding, and a spacious bathroom with high-end amenities. Whether unwinding after a day of exploration or indulging in an extended stay, our suites provide a sanctuary of tranquility and indulgence in the heart of the Fergana Valley.
